newsitem.title: BELGIUM: NATO rejects any conditions on expansion.
newsitem.headline: NATO rejects any conditions on expansion.

text.p: NATO has rejected a Russian attempt to link NATO enlargement to a new treaty with Russia governing all aspects of its relationship with the alliance, a senior NATO official said on Monday.
The official said alliance Secretary-General Javier Solana had told Russian security supremo Alexander Lebed that NATO saw the two issues moving ahead in parallel, but without any link.

"Mr Lebed, and the Russian government, favours a situation where first of all you have a NATO-Russia agreement, charter, or document and only when that has been achieved do you move on to enlargement...
"Mr Solana made clear today we reject that approach," the official said.
He added that the talks with Lebed, on his first visit to the West, had been "very constructive", saying Moscow's argument appeared to accept enlargement was inevitable.
"If Russia says it wants a sequential approach, then Russia also says 'Yes' to enlargement...There are gaps between us, but they are not unbridgeable chasms."
